subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “A student named Nina visited for a report.”?
options: She found a photo of her street from fifty years ago.
Workers cleaning a storage room found old election posters from many years ago.
Eric looked at a map from one hundred years ago.
A family found a damaged photo of their great-grandparents.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「A student named Nina visited for a report. She found a photo of her street from fifty years ago.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Workers cleaning a storage room found old election posters from many years ago.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Eric looked at a map from one hundred years ago.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A family found a damaged photo of their great-grandparents.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
